about: What WuWa VR must do, in which states, and how each cell is checked. dev/qa.py reads it: `check` validates, `plan` lists what a candidate must pass, `record` adds a result to qa/results.jsonl, `report` writes docs/QA-MATRIX.md, `session` turns a UEVR log into automatic results. docs/QA.md explains the process.

states.fulltall: Full VR, taller UI layout (16:9 off, or the character screen)
states.switch: A view switch while it is on screen (full VR / stereo / mono, both ways)
states.dialogue: Story dialogue or a story cutscene
states.menu: A full-screen game menu open (journey log, map, Terminal, inventory)

kinds.invariant: dev/qa.py session finds it in the UEVR log of any play session
kinds.simulator: a scripted simulator run (scratchpad tools today; to be moved into dev/)
kinds.manual: a person looks; the owner in the headset is the final word

features.name: Install, update and launch into VR
features.how: Install the candidate from the Test Launcher, launch on both game copies. The log route lines say which copy and runtime.

features.name: Every game-code check passes on this game build
features.how: Each route logs `[WuWaStereoCode] route=... verified` or why it refused. After a game update this is the list of what broke (docs/GAME-UPDATE.md).

features.name: Both eyes share one game camera (no one-eye shake or zoom)
features.how: Story shot with camera shake (Shorekeeper quest, Aalto at Black Shores, the lantern shot): both eyes move together. Simulator: shake_step.py per-eye motion.

features.name: Far trees and foliage match in both eyes
features.how: Look at distant trees; no tree visible in one eye only.

features.name: Far lighting (CLV) matches after teleports
features.how: Teleport, look at the far landscape: same brightness in both eyes.

features.name: Ambient occlusion matches in both eyes
features.how: Rocks and roofs shaded the same in both eyes.

features.name: God rays match (pagoda, storm sky)
features.how: Pagoda god rays line up in both eyes.

features.name: Depth of field (blur) in both eyes; LT + RT, L3 toggles it
features.how: Dialogue close-up: background blur in both eyes; L3 chord turns it off and on.

features.name: Fades reach both eyes; no one-eye frame after a load
features.how: Login, loading screens, story cuts: no black or white single eye.

features.name: Tree wind moves the same in both eyes
features.how: Windy trees near the camera (Lelouche's report). Open issue.

features.name: LT + RT, R3: click full VR / stereo; hold mono and back; repeat while the triggers stay held
features.how: Hold both triggers, click R3 several times, then hold R3 0.8 s twice.

features.name: Story videos switch to mono theatre and back
features.how: A pre-rendered story video (cutscene with a video player). The log shows `Automatic mono theatre active`.

features.name: Story pictures switch to the stereo screen and back
features.how: Abby's dialogue, main story 1-8: three pictures.

features.name: Automatic cinema on by default; story scenes keep the current view
features.how: Fresh profile and a 1.2.2 profile: on; dialogue does not change the view.

features.name: Cinematic framing matches between the eyes (letterbox)
features.how: Letterboxed cutscene: same bar heights in both eyes.

features.name: Diorama: scale, its own camera, and back
features.how: L3 + RT on and off; diorama scale and camera on the Quick and Camera pages.

features.name: Hide characters at your eyes (LT + RT, Y)
features.how: Over-the-shoulder story shot: the head at your eyes disappears whole.

features.name: HUD and menus laid out for the view they are shown in
features.how: Open the journey log in each view, and switch views with it open: it fills the screen correctly every time.

features.name: Mouse and controller cursor hit what they point at
features.how: Journey log, Terminal and character screen: click items at the corners and centre with the mouse and with the controller cursor; switch views and click again.
features.open: taller layout and character screen: mouse fixed in test 17l, needs the headset

features.name: Story scenes in 16:9 with the taller layout
features.how: Taller layout chosen: conversations switch to 16:9 and back.

features.name: Character screen floor reflection stays live
features.how: Open Resonators: the reflection follows the character; tabs Weapon, Echoes, Chain, Forte, skins.

features.name: WuWa VR menu: open, settings, defaults, X / Delete reset, save switch
features.how: L3 + R3 opens it; change a setting, reset it with X, close.

features.name: Classic UEVR window and emergency keys
features.how: Ctrl+Shift+End and Ctrl+Shift+Home; Back returns to the WuWa VR menu.

features.name: Every text translated in all ten languages
features.how: python dev/i18n/check_all.py

features.name: Game, first person, fixed camera and freecam
features.how: L3 + RB, L3 + View, double R3.

features.name: Camera height, L3 + Y / X and L3 + Y + X reset
features.how: First person or fixed camera.
